medium-native-ansi-bbs-nightboard.name: ANSI BBS Nightboard
medium-native-ansi-bbs-nightboard.form: a dial-up bulletin board at 2 a.m., where ANSI title screens in sixteen colors, block-character art, and one phone line make a neighborhood out of text

rw-manual-acetate-tab-board.name: Manual Acetate Tab Board
rw-manual-acetate-tab-board.form: a boxed-software reference manual lying open at a tabbed section, where the coloured divider board carries no mark at all and every paragraph, figure and keystroke sits on a punched acetate leaf hinged a millimetre above it, the whole book's extent drawn as a stepped tab rail down the fore edge

operate-c-cracktro-scroller-queue.name: Cracktro Scroller Queue
operate-c-cracktro-scroller-queue.form: A worked queue built from a cracktro title screen: one bitmap face riding baselines over an emissive black void, where rank is depth, fields of grey dust drift behind the work at layered speeds, and nothing is ever enclosed by a rule or a box.

signals-instruments-split-flap-concourse.name: Split Flap Concourse
signals-instruments-split-flap-concourse.form: a rail concourse split-flap board at rush hour, where cascading letter flaps, platform columns, and departure rhythm hold a thousand travelers in one gaze

pop-culture-shelf-spy-dossier-title-sequ.name: Spy Dossier Title Sequence

design-canon-creator-hardware-bench.name: Creator Hardware Bench
design-canon-creator-hardware-bench.form: a creator-hardware desk instrument, bone and putty keycaps with dye-sublimated mono legends gridded into a gunmetal chassis, one safety-orange action key, knurled aluminum knobs, and a small amber status screen

system: Palette/material: bone and putty keycap grays on gunmetal, charcoal legends as body ink, safety orange reserved for the action that matters, amber screen glow as live state

reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-plankton-.name: Plankton Wake Stars
reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-plankton-.form: a night sea igniting with bioluminescent plankton, with every wake tracing motion, fading memory, and currents revealed by living light

reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-plankton-.webLeverage: GPU particles react to pointer velocity and advect through a visible current field.

paper-folds-pleats-deployable-curved-cre.name: Curved Crease Shell
paper-folds-pleats-deployable-curved-cre.form: a circular sheet folded along one sweeping curved crease, where paper rises into a rigid shell without straight facets or added support
paper-folds-pleats-deployable-curved-cre.spark: The cream disc lifts along one charcoal arc and locks into a saddle whose shadow looks drawn with a compass in midair.
system: Palette/material: cream cotton paper as ground, one charcoal compass arc as the active crease, graphite shadow gradients for depth, body notes in soft black ink

paper-folds-pleats-deployable-curved-cre.webLeverage: A curve-driven deformation model can show how one line produces spatial rigidity while retaining a precise 2D source.

textiles-weave-drape-fashion-sneaker-box.name: Sneaker Box Stacks
textiles-weave-drape-fashion-sneaker-box.form: a sneaker archive wall, stacked cardboard boxes with silhouette line art printed on the ends, colorway names read as poetry beside monospaced size runs, tissue folded inside each lid
textiles-weave-drape-fashion-sneaker-box.spark: You slide a box from a stack taller than you; the end label lists the colorway name like a line of verse, the lid lifts with a cardboard sigh, and tissue paper folds back from the shape you already know by silhouette.
system: Palette/material: burnt orange box board as the ground, black one-line silhouette art for ink, tissue white interiors, the colorway chip strip carrying accent states

Topology/navigation: a wall of stacked boxes indexed by their end labels; you browse the stack face, pull a box halfway, and open the lid to go deeper

textiles-weave-drape-fashion-sneaker-box.webLeverage: css 3d transforms hinging box lids open on interaction, grid re-shelving the stack from wall to single column across breakpoints

pop-culture-shelf-anime-command-center.name: Anime Command Center
pop-culture-shelf-anime-command-center.form: a nineties mecha-anime crisis wall, phosphor orange and acid green type on absolute black, hazard-chevron bands framing bilingual kanji-over-caps labels, seven-segment countdowns at monumental scale
pop-culture-shelf-anime-command-center.spark: sirens drop to a hum as the lights go down; the wall floods orange, seven-segment digits taller than you count backward, hazard chevrons crawl the border while kanji headlines snap over spaced caps and a red bar creeps toward its limit
system: Palette/material: phosphor orange and acid green on absolute black ground, red reserved for condition bars, alarms invert to yellow-on-black chevrons with a red-boxed headline

pop-culture-shelf-anime-command-center.webLeverage: css text-shadow does the phosphor glow, canvas draws the rainbow contour plots, and a steps() animation ticks the seven-segment countdown digits

wayfinding-cartography-signage-midnight-.name: Midnight Transit Diagram
wayfinding-cartography-signage-midnight-.form: a metropolitan rail map fired as a midnight-blue enamel mural, where scarlet, cobalt, amber, and green lines bend at disciplined angles, interchange circles bloom at crossings, and the entire city becomes a legible promise of movement
wayfinding-cartography-signage-midnight-.spark: Under the station's white light, four colored lines meet in one porcelain interchange; a fingertip follows the scarlet route outward until the dense center opens toward the river.
system: Palette/material: midnight-blue enamel ground with porcelain white station ticks, scarlet, cobalt, amber, and green line inks, the chosen line burning brightest
Type/composition: humanist transit sans in fixed-size station labels, lines bending only at 45 and 90 degrees, the diagram's discipline is the composition

wayfinding-cartography-signage-midnight-.webLeverage: Live service state can recompute only affected routes and transfer promises, while deep-linked itineraries, native search, and offline caching preserve a usable journey beyond the mural.

signals-instruments-drum-machine-step-ro.name: Drum Machine Step Row
signals-instruments-drum-machine-step-ro.form: an early-80s rhythm machine step row, sixteen candy-colored step keys under a running chase light, pattern banks behind them and a tempo readout above, accents lighting deeper as the loop swings around again
signals-instruments-drum-machine-step-ro.spark: you punch four steps into the red quarter of the row and hit run, the chase light comes around, and the empty machine suddenly has a pulse you made, so you lean in and accent the offbeat
system: Palette/material: charcoal panel ground, the step row quartered in red, orange, yellow, and white keys, lit LEDs as the only glow, silkscreen white labels for everything else
Type/composition: instrument names as small silkscreen caps above their rows, the tempo in a red segmented readout, the sixteen-step row as the page's one unbroken line
Topology/navigation: patterns are pages and banks are chapters; the step row is a timeline you write into place, and the chase light always tells you where now is
Controls/state: tapping a step arms it and lights it, a second tap accents it brighter, the chase light sweeps in tempo, and an empty pattern is sixteen dark keys of invitation

signals-instruments-drum-machine-step-ro.webLeverage: web audio clocks the chase light and playback while each step key stays a toggle button operable by keyboard

medium-native-hypercard-stack-shoebox.name: Hypercard Stack Shoebox
medium-native-hypercard-stack-shoebox.form: a HyperCard shoebox stack, where black-and-white cards link through buttons anyone can paint and the tool for reading is also the tool for making
medium-native-hypercard-stack-shoebox.spark: A shoebox of black-and-white cards where clicking a hand-painted button flips you somewhere the author felt you should go next, and the paint tools are one menu away.
system: Palette/material: one-bit black on white with stipple-dither grays and no color anywhere, the pressed button inverting to solid black as its active state

medium-native-hypercard-stack-shoebox.webLeverage: History API and deep links make every card addressable, while in-place editing keeps reader and author one keypress apart.

sd-seedbed-lobes.name: Seedbed Lobes
sd-seedbed-lobes.form: A saturated green field with a floating white capsule bar riding above it, an oversized grotesque headline set flush-left, and a flat vector cast spilling across the lower right. Below, a huge cream panel rises with a 48px top radius, carrying green circular icon wells.
sd-seedbed-lobes.spark: One colour owns the whole viewport, and the interface floats on top of it as detached white lozenges. Nothing is inset; everything is a pill or a rounded slab hovering over the green, so the page reads as objects on a lawn rather than boxes in a grid.
system: Palette/material: Ground #82CC5C; ink #2F3130 (never #000); white #FFFFFF capsules; cream panel #F2EFE3; accent tomato #F0574C, cobalt #1B8FF5, yellow #F5D42B.

Controls/state: Buttons are white pills with a 40px green disc holding a chevron; hamburger is a green circle; avatar a blue circle. Colour lives in the disc, never the label.
Responsive/motion: Scroll swells a green lobe; chip crosses its capsule on hover; 0.4s overshoot.
sd-seedbed-lobes.webLeverage: Pill navigation detaches from the page edge; scroll-linked blob scaling and hover chip travel inside a capsule are cheap in CSS and impossible in print.

notation-diagram-systems-patent-drawing-.name: Patent Drawing Sheet
notation-diagram-systems-patent-drawing-.form: a utility patent drawing sheet, an invention exploded into numbered figures in ruled ink line, reference numerals tied to parts by curved leader lines, hatching standing in for every material, witnessed and dated in the margin
notation-diagram-systems-patent-drawing-.spark: You unroll the sheet and Fig. 2 blooms into an exploded view, forty parts hanging on invisible threads, numeral 23 arcing on a curved leader to the one washer the whole claim depends on.
system: Palette/material: india ink line on white bond inside a single ruled border, section hatching as the only fill, one carmine annotation ink reserved for what is under examination

notation-diagram-systems-patent-drawing-.webLeverage: svg leader lines and hatch patterns redraw responsively while an animated transform explodes assemblies along their axes

textiles-weave-drape-fashion-drawcord-tr.spark: The cape begins as a black semicircle; one gold cord is pulled and the cloth rises into a pleated shell around the shoulders.
system: Palette/material: matte black silk as ground, one gold drawcord as accent and control, channel stitching in graphite, gathered shadow rendered in slate

operate-b-struck-cathode-gauze.name: Struck Cathode Gauze
operate-b-struck-cathode-gauze.form: An access-control surface built as a cathode numeral stack: every possible value present at once as a dark ghost behind a fine bronze anode gauze, one struck forward in glowing orange, with no box, rule or divider anywhere on a plane that runs past every edge.

operate-a-cutting-bench-select-rail.form: A film cutting bench flattened into a sheet: a perforated select rail crossing a grain-orange field, each step a punched frame held between two pins, the place you stopped marked by a folded tape flag, and everything set aside still hanging on pins below the rail.

signals-instruments-darkroom-safelight-b.name: Darkroom Safelight Bay
signals-instruments-darkroom-safelight-b.form: a printing darkroom under amber safelight, where enlarger beams, timed baths, and drying lines stage photographs into slow deliberate existence
signals-instruments-darkroom-safelight-b.spark: In the developer tray, gray ghosts gather into a face; the timer ticks, and pulling the print too early is a real loss.

scientific-notation-oscilloscope-signal-.name: Oscilloscope Signal Bench
scientific-notation-oscilloscope-signal-.form: a crt oscilloscope on a signal bench, phosphor trace riding an etched graticule while detented knobs set channel, timebase, and trigger

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-cloud-qu.name: Cloud Quarry
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-cloud-qu.form: a cloud quarry, where workers cut blocks of weather, reveal blue voids, and assemble temporary buildings that rain from their own walls

vernacular-ephemera-boarding-pass-and-ga.form: a travel document surface pairing a segmented boarding pass with a live gate board, the pass carrying a scannable block and a sequence number while the board reranks flights by departure and reflows a changed gate in place

medium-native-webring-homepage-lane.form: a hand-built homepage neighborhood, where tiled backgrounds, guestbooks, under-construction signs, and webring badges link strangers into a lane of personal rooms
medium-native-webring-homepage-lane.spark: Every page is somebody's room: a starfield background, a song you can stop, and a webring badge promising a neighbor either way.
system: Palette/material: tiled starfield black with neon lime text, royal-blue links purpling once visited, the under-construction amber stripe marking anything unfinished
Type/composition: default serif body under exuberant display headings, centered layout ruled by horizontal lines, badges and counters clustering at the page's foot
Topology/navigation: spaces link laterally through ring badges: previous, random, next; discovery beats hierarchy.
Controls/state: visitor traces are celebrated; counters, guestbook entries, and last-updated stamps are first-class.
Responsive/motion: rooms keep their handmade proportions with honest scrollbars; ornament loops pause under
medium-native-webring-homepage-lane.webLeverage: Real cross-page ring navigation with shared state via URL, plus a live guestbook as the social layer.

signals-instruments-pinball-backglass.name: Pinball Backglass
signals-instruments-pinball-backglass.form: a pinball machine's backglass and playfield, a tilted world of ramps and rollovers where score erupts on painted glass above the physics below
signals-instruments-pinball-backglass.spark: The ball rockets off the plunger, kisses two bumpers into a scream of chimes, and the painted magician on the backglass lights up as the score reels slam forward a thousand at a time.
system: Palette/material: saturated backglass enamel reds, yellows, and blues over mirror silver, playfield lacquer and chrome ball below; lit inserts flare the active target
Type/composition: airbrushed carnival lettering and drop-shadow score numerals on the glass, playfield labels curving with the lanes; the tilted plane composes everything
Topology/navigation: one inclined plane holds every target; the ball's path is the traversal, and everything is reachable but nothing is guaranteed
Controls/state: two flippers and a plunger are the entire input; lamps, chimes, and score reels answer every hit with disproportionate ceremony
Responsive/motion: portrait shows the full incline, landscape splits playfield from backglass
signals-instruments-pinball-backglass.webLeverage: pointer and keyboard flippers drive a real 2d physics simulation; the Vibration API answers slingshot hits on touch devices

kinetic-sculpture-automata-crank-paper-m.name: Crank Paper Menagerie
kinetic-sculpture-automata-crank-paper-m.form: a hand-cranked paper menagerie of tabs, bellows, and pinned joints, where humble folds produce a surprising procession of motion
kinetic-sculpture-automata-crank-paper-m.spark: The crank turns; a white fox bows, a crimson bird opens concertina wings, and their shadows cross on the paper wall behind them.
system: Palette/material: cut white paper on kraft board as the ground, charcoal cast shadow as body ink, one crimson fold reserved for the figure currently in motion
Type/composition: hand-cut letterpress caps with visible tab and slot marks, captions on folded paper strips beneath each figure, one crank line ruling the base
Topology/navigation: Advance through a procession while each figure opens into its own linkage and supporting details.
Controls/state: Turn, pause, reverse, and inspect joints with folded, tensioned, extended, and resting states.
Responsive/motion: Reduce the procession to one figure per viewport and provide illustrated keyframes beside every control.
kinetic-sculpture-automata-crank-paper-m.webLeverage: Pointer and keyboard input can drive a common crank timeline, synchronizing SVG cut-paper layers with accessible step descriptions.

pop-culture-shelf-sapeur-portrait-plate.name: Sapeur Portrait Plate
pop-culture-shelf-sapeur-portrait-plate.form: a congolese dandy portrait plate, a figure posed full length against a plain painted backdrop in a precisely coordinated three-color suit, the label of every garment named in a caption ruled beneath the frame
pop-culture-shelf-sapeur-portrait-plate.spark: a man standing perfectly still against a painted wall in a suit of exactly three colors that should not work together and completely do, with every label named in a line underneath.
system: Palette/material: a plain painted studio backdrop in one flat hue behind suiting in exactly three coordinated colors, everything photographed in even frontal light
Type/composition: a full-length figure centered on the backdrop, a ruled caption beneath naming each garment's label, and a thin printed frame around the plate
Topology/navigation: the plate is a portrait series, so navigation moves between figures whose color coordination changes against the same backdrop
Controls/state: controls are garment captions, the active one draws a leader to its garment, and named ones keep a small printed tick
Responsive/motion: the backdrop crops around the held figure, and motion is a backdrop hue change between plates
pop-culture-shelf-sapeur-portrait-plate.webLeverage: svg leader lines from caption to garment on hover state, responsive backdrop cropping, and hue transitions between plates

studio-dumbar-identity.name: Studio Dumbar Identity
studio-dumbar-identity.form: a modular identity system, where photographed reality and hard vector bars snap together under one loud grammar of colored blocks
studio-dumbar-identity.spark: A staged photograph tilts under a stack of saturated bars. Loose vector marks scatter like dropped confetti, then lock to an invisible module. The system stays recognizable no matter how far the parts are thrown.
system: Palette/material: Primary saturated blocks, cyan, magenta, yellow, and grass green, over cool grey and photographic mid-tones; flat vector fills against real photographic depth.
Type/composition: Neutral Dutch grotesque set small and businesslike, overrun by oversized colored bars and playful vector fragments
Topology/navigation: Move by color band, by module cell, and by photographic scene.
Controls/state: Snap, layer, and scatter; selecting a band brings its bar forward and pushes the photo layer back with a parallax shift.
Responsive/motion: Bars restack from horizontal rows to vertical columns as width shrinks; reduced-motion places them directly with no rotation or slide.
studio-dumbar-identity.webLeverage: Compose colored bars and photo panels as CSS grid layers with mix-blend-mode multiply, so overlaps produce the system's signature secondary colors.

vernacular-ephemera-loteria-tabla-night.name: Loteria Tabla Night
vernacular-ephemera-loteria-tabla-night.form: a backyard loteria night, a deck of numbered icon cards in flat carnival color, each image named and numbered in the same breath, players marking their tablas with dried beans while the caller sings riddles instead of names
vernacular-ephemera-loteria-tabla-night.spark: the caller sings the riddle before the name, and half the table laughs and reaches for beans while you scan your tabla for the mermaid, one row short of shouting
system: Palette/material: sun yellow, rose, and turquoise flat fields behind each icon, heavy black contour ink, carnival red card borders, a dried bean's brown as the mark of progress
Type/composition: one icon per card, centered, named beneath in spaced caps with its number, tablas as four-by-four grids of the same icons, no image ever cropped
Topology/navigation: the deck is the sequence and the tabla is the map; the caller's drawn card is always the current item, and your grid fills in whatever order fate deals
Controls/state: a called card flips face-up for everyone, placing a bean commits a match, a completed row shouts itself, and unclaimed matches sit as quiet regret between rounds
Responsive/motion: tablas stay square and shrink whole on phones with the called card pinned above; motion is a card flip and a bean drop
vernacular-ephemera-loteria-tabla-night.webLeverage: multiplayer card calls sync over websocket while each tabla remains a keyboard-operable grid with live-region announcements

medium-native-ascii-live-scene-render.name: Ascii Live Scene Render
medium-native-ascii-live-scene-render.form: a live scene rendered as typewriter characters, where density of glyphs stands in for light and an at-sign can be a face if it moves correctly
medium-native-ascii-live-scene-render.spark: A rotating skull made entirely of dollar signs and periods; you squint and it is sculpture, you focus and it is text, and it is both at every distance.
system: Palette/material: single-ink phosphor, green or amber on black; tone is glyph density from period to at-sign, and the densest glyph is the highlight
Type/composition: one strict monospace grid as the entire composition, the luminance ramp serving as the typographic scale, captions living inside the same grid
Topology/navigation: the world is a fixed character grid; you move the camera, and the alphabet re-renders the view.
Controls/state: the luminance ramp is the palette; swapping ramps changes mood while geometry stays put.
Responsive/motion: cell count adapts to viewport while glyphs stay monospace-true
medium-native-ascii-live-scene-render.webLeverage: Canvas or camera frames sample down to a live glyph grid, so video, 3D, and pointer input all become selectable text.

signals-instruments-vu-meter-bridge.name: Vu Meter Bridge
signals-instruments-vu-meter-bridge.form: a vu-meter bridge across a recording desk, a long row of ballistic needles behind glass that all lean into the red on the same downbeat
signals-instruments-vu-meter-bridge.spark: Twenty needles lie asleep against their left pins until the chorus hits, and then the whole bridge leans right together, trembling at the edge of the red like horses at a gate.
system: Palette/material: warm ivory meter faces behind glass, black scale arcs and needles as the working ink, walnut and steel desk frame; the arc past zero is the only red
Type/composition: the VU scale's flared numerals and minus-to-plus arc on every face, channel numbers in strip labels below; identical meters repeat as the row's ruler
Topology/navigation: identical channels stand shoulder to shoulder; you read the room by sweeping the whole row, never by opening one meter
Controls/state: each needle integrates the last 300ms with weighted overshoot; the arc past zero is the only red the instrument allows
Responsive/motion: narrow viewports stack the row into bar ballistics
signals-instruments-vu-meter-bridge.webLeverage: an AnalyserNode feeds real signal levels; canvas needles obey true VU ballistics with mass and damping, never instant values

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-alphabet.name: Alphabet Storm
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-alphabet.form: an alphabet storm, where letters condense into words, break into weather, and reshape the landscape according to grammar
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-alphabet.spark: Black letters gather into CLOUD, burst into rain, and carve the word RIVER across white ground; changing one vowel turns the current into a field of silver ravens.
system: Palette/material: paper white ground, storm-letter black as both body ink and weather mass, one silver flash for words mid-transformation, rain gray for spent grammar
Type/composition: a single monumental grotesk behaving as matter, kerning loosening into wind, words breaking across lines as literal weather fronts on an open field
Topology/navigation: Travel between letter fronts, word formations, grammatical forces, and the landscapes they produce.
Controls/state: Type, split, conjugate, and recombine language while physical consequences remain reversible.
Responsive/motion: Use one word-weather event per phone viewport and preserve readable text throughout transformation.
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-alphabet.webLeverage: Text parsing, procedural particles, and semantic rules turn typed language into deterministic weather with accessible narrative descriptions.

design-annual-s-plate-section.name: Design Annual S Plate Section
design-annual-s-plate-section.form: a design annual's plate section on uncoated near-white stock, where registration crosshairs mark every plate corner, a letterpressed circular attribution stamp sits half off the image, hairline rules divide the credits row, and one grotesque carries display and caption alike
design-annual-s-plate-section.spark: The sheet is almost white but never neutral: it drifts warm at one corner and green at another, so the ink reads as printed rather than rendered. Everything else is registration furniture — crosses, dots, hairlines — and a single periwinkle stamp to prove a human signed it.
system: Palette/material: ground #F5F4F6, drifting to #FAF6F5 and #EEF3EF at edges; ink #16181A never pure black; single accent seal #DCDDF3; hairlines #C9C7C4 1px; photography untinted.
Type/composition: one grotesque throughout — 400 weight, 92px display at -0.02em, 17px body; labels 11px mono uppercase at 0.14em; 12-col grid, 40px gutters, no italics.
Topology/navigation: one continuous sheet; 72px sticky bar of mono tokens; crosshair plus marks register plate corners; 8px dot matrix fills voids; hairlines split the 4-up row.
Controls/state: primary is a filled #16181A rect, 0 radius, mono caps 0.12em; secondary a 1px outline rect; nav arrows 44px circles; background inverts 0.1s ease.
Responsive/motion: stamp's text ring turns 25s linear infinite and lifts 4px on hover 0.6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1); tiles step one column at that curve; no parallax.
design-annual-s-plate-section.webLeverage: Sticky mono token bar, SVG textPath stamp on infinite linear rotation, pointer-local dot-matrix fades, and a whole grid built from 1px hairlines and CSS crosshairs.

aww2-zoo-gardens-guide-map.name: Aww2 Zoo Gardens Guide Map
aww2-zoo-gardens-guide-map.form: a zoo and gardens guide map, where every area is a swelling lobe of flat colour and the coastline between lobes does all the dividing, and where a lobe can open in its middle so the page ground shows through it as water
aww2-zoo-gardens-guide-map.spark: A summer opening-morning guide map creased into eight panels: an apple-green headland swelling across the fold, a coral flamingo standing right on its edge with one foot out over the cream, and a yellow capsule pinned to the coastline reading GATE.
system: Palette/material: Flat unmodulated colour, no grain: green #8ED462 land on cream #F5F1E4 water, ink #2C2E2A. Photographs keep their own colour, cropped to a lobe, never tinted.
Type/composition: One grotesk at one weight; display at 0.95 leading, -0.06em. Prose is ink on cream, white, green or yellow; coral and blue carry labels only.
Topology/navigation: One lobe dominates each screen, swelling until its coast leaves the frame on two sides; a lobe may open in its middle and let the ground through as water.
Controls/state: Controls are capsules in yellow #F5E211, coral #FF705D, blue #2BA0FF, lilac #EBC1FF; a round chip rides its trailing edge and crosses to the leading edge when live.
Responsive/motion: Everything that moves takes 0.4s and overshoots before settling. Scroll redraws the coastline continuously; at narrow widths the coast runs down the frame.
aww2-zoo-gardens-guide-map.webLeverage: Every area is one SVG path; scroll advances a single timeline that morphs the coastline, and the same path clips the illustration and the type, so one geometry drives layout, art and state together.

medium-native-ebru-floated-pigment.name: Ebru Floated Pigment
medium-native-ebru-floated-pigment.form: a bath of thickened water where pigment floats and is combed into figures before being lifted onto paper in one contact, every mark made by moving liquid rather than by drawing on a surface
medium-native-ebru-floated-pigment.spark: Every drop pushes the last one into a ring, and you comb through the whole thing with a single hair before laying a sheet down once and lifting the only copy there will ever be.
system: Palette/material: pigment floating on a thickened bath, colours never mixing but displacing each other, lifted onto sized paper in a single contact
Type/composition: figures drawn by dragging a stylus through floating colour, with each new drop pushing the previous ones outward into rings
Topology/navigation: everything is made on one surface in one pass, so navigation is intervening in a liquid rather than moving between views
Controls/state: controls are stylus strokes, each one permanently displaces the colour around it, and a lift ends the composition
Responsive/motion: the bath fills any frame and figures redistribute, and motion is pigment displacing outward from each new drop
medium-native-ebru-floated-pigment.webLeverage: a fluid-displacement canvas simulation with stylus interaction, irreversible stroke state, and a one-shot lift transition

pop-culture-shelf-teen-magazine-quiz.name: Teen Magazine Quiz
pop-culture-shelf-teen-magazine-quiz.form: a nineties teen-magazine quiz spread, lettered checkboxes marching down torn-edge photo collage, gel-pen doodles over halftone crushes, a verdict box waiting at the fold in pink and acid green
pop-culture-shelf-teen-magazine-quiz.spark: you press the magazine flat on the carpet, circle mostly Bs in silver gel pen, count the ticks twice, and flip to the verdict box under a torn photo of a crush to find out what your summer holds
system: Palette/material: newsprint white ground with halftone photo blocks, hot pink and acid green as the shouting pair, gel-pen silver ink circling whatever is chosen
Type/composition: chunky condensed headlines at a tilt, questions in friendly serif columns, answers as lettered checkbox rows, every block torn and taped into the collage
Topology/navigation: the spread is the space; questions run down columns, mostly-As logic branches you across the fold, and the verdict box is the destination
Controls/state: choosing an answer circles it in gel-pen ink, tallies collect as margin tick marks, the verdict box flips open only when every row is marked
Responsive/motion: columns stack to one scrolling strip on phones with the verdict pinned last; motion is pen scribble draw-on
pop-culture-shelf-teen-magazine-quiz.webLeverage: svg stroke-dashoffset draws the gel-pen circles, css columns and rotated clip-path tears build the collage, form state tallies the verdict

reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-chromatop.name: Chromatophore Skin Language
reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-chromatop.form: a cephalopod skin becoming a living display, with expanding chromatophores, traveling patterns, texture change, and context-dependent signals
reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-chromatop.spark: A pale animal crosses patterned stone and its skin becomes waves, eyes, and ridges in less than a heartbeat.
system: Palette/material: pale mantle-cream as ground, red-brown chromatophores as body ink, one iridophore blue-green flash marking the active signal, dark ridges as texture
Type/composition: a variable typeface whose weight tracks pigment expansion, patterns traveling body to skin-cell as waves, signals drawn directly onto the surface
Topology/navigation: Navigate whole body, skin region, pigment cell, pattern wave, and environmental trigger.
Controls/state: Change context, draw signals, and show neutral, camouflaging, warning, and communicating states.
Responsive/motion: Flatten skin into an inspectable living textile on phones; pattern speed is adjustable.
reefs-bioluminescent-nocturnal-chromatop.webLeverage: GPU cellular shaders and displacement textures render signal, color, and texture together.

posters-covers-sleeves-fight-poster.name: Fight Poster
posters-covers-sleeves-fight-poster.form: a boxing fight poster, two names in slab caps colliding at a versus mark, faces mirrored in confrontation over a stacked undercard in shrinking type
posters-covers-sleeves-fight-poster.spark: Outside the arena in the rain, two heavyweight profiles glare across a gold VS while the undercard shrinks line by line into names only their mothers came to see.
system: Palette/material: newsprint cream ground, heavy black slab ink for the two names, one arena gold reserved for the versus mark and the live selection
Type/composition: condensed slab caps at collision scale, each name set to fill its half to the edge, date and venue in letterpress smalls beneath the mark
Topology/navigation: the sheet splits along a central versus axis, each half belongs to one opponent, everything else stacks beneath in ranked shrinking rows
Controls/state: any comparison becomes the two halves, the favored side's slab caps sit heavier, the undercard ranks the rest by type size alone
Responsive/motion: halves stack vertically on narrow frames with the versus mark as hinge; motion is a title-card punch-in
posters-covers-sleeves-fight-poster.webLeverage: CSS grid mirrors the two halves for any compare, with a draggable versus divider rebalancing them.

generative-art-computational-color-chord.name: Generative Art Computational Color Chord Counterpoint
generative-art-computational-color-chord.form: an overhead canopy of translucent indigo, madder, and saffron silk crossing a sunlit courtyard, where independently tensioned banners overlap into passing color chords and sudden clear sky
generative-art-computational-color-chord.spark: A wind lifts the indigo span above the saffron; violet races across the paving, a madder band joins for one deep brown chord, and then the courtyard flashes white again.
system: Palette/material: translucent indigo, madder, and saffron silk over sun-white paving, overlap violets and browns as computed chord states, clear sky white as rest
Type/composition: light wide-tracked sans labels pinned at each banner's tensioned edge, the composition horizontal silk lanes crossing one bright open field
Topology/navigation: Move among individual banner voices, their crossing zones, the courtyard ground, and moments when several colors coincide.
Controls/state: Tension, release, solo, and align bands with separate, approaching, overlapping, dissonant, and clear states labeled beyond color.
Responsive/motion: Recompose the canopy as synchronized translucent lanes on compact screens and provide patterned stills for
generative-art-computational-color-chord.webLeverage: Synchronized state channels can be soloed or combined in real time, making overlap a task-bearing joint state that remains scrubbable, comparable, and noncolor-coded.

exhibition-museum-curation-provenance-ri.name: Exhibition Museum Curation Provenance Ribbon
exhibition-museum-curation-provenance-ri.form: a provenance ribbon, where ownership, extraction, exchange, repair, silence, and restitution fold through one object's life without becoming a bureaucratic table
exhibition-museum-curation-provenance-ri.spark: A red silk ribbon leaves a temple, disappears for forty years, reappears beneath a dealer's stamp, and splits at the present into display, return, and unresolved claim.
system: Palette/material: archival buff as ground, one continuous red silk ribbon as the custody line, gaps rendered as gray unwoven thread, dealer stamps in fading ink
Type/composition: ledger serifs with dated small caps at every fold, known passages in solid type and inferred ones in hairline, one ribbon-led column
Topology/navigation: Follow the ribbon through dated custody, geographic movement, gaps, and competing claims.
Controls/state: Open evidence at any fold, compare accounts, and distinguish known, inferred, and disputed passages.
Responsive/motion: Unroll the ribbon vertically on phones and keep uncertainty attached to every transition.
exhibition-museum-curation-provenance-ri.webLeverage: A citation-backed temporal graph, map projection, and revision history reveal provenance claims without implying certainty the evidence lacks.

posters-covers-sleeves-saul-bass-title.name: Saul Bass Title
posters-covers-sleeves-saul-bass-title.form: a saul bass title sequence, cut-paper shapes and a single jittering line building meaning across timed cards on a flat color field
posters-covers-sleeves-saul-bass-title.spark: A black cut-paper arm reaches across a burnt-orange field while brass stabs, and in ninety seconds of jittering silhouettes an entire story is told without showing a single face.
system: Palette/material: one flat saturated field per card, burnt orange, ink black, and bone white, the field color swapping per act while silhouettes stay black
Type/composition: skinny hand-set caps sitting slightly off baseline, one idea per card in hard asymmetry, credits ranked as timed cards rather than columns
Topology/navigation: a timed sequence of full-bleed cards, one idea per card; jumping ahead scrubs the sequence rather than abandoning it
Controls/state: everything is a cut-paper symbol, states change by swapping the silhouette rather than decorating it; a jittery hand-drawn line marks the live element
Responsive/motion: shapes are flat and scale-free so cards recompose at any width; motion is staccato paper-cut jumps
posters-covers-sleeves-saul-bass-title.webLeverage: SVG shape morphs animate the paper-cut swaps, with scroll-driven animation timelines advancing each card.

rw-centre-rail-reference-setting.name: Centre Rail Reference Setting
rw-centre-rail-reference-setting.form: a reference-setting page drawn by a ruling engine, two short-measure text columns twinned around a fixed centre rail of keys, the whole block held small inside a wide annotation margin where the apparatus hangs and overlaps the block's edge
rw-centre-rail-reference-setting.spark: A wide-margin edition open under a lamp: two dense columns of small roman, a hairline channel of vermilion letter-keys running down between them, and four inches of bare paper all around where a previous reader has ruled one note and bracketed it back into the line it belongs to.
system: Palette/material: iron-black ink and one rubric vermilion on unbleached bone, three values only. A ruling engine draws every rule, bracket and detent at one device pixel.
Type/composition: Brevier body is Miller Text 17 to 19px on 1.5 leading, two columns of 34 to 40 characters round a 6 to 9 character rail. Pearl 11px small caps sets apparatus.
Topology/navigation: the centre rail is the one moving part, carrying keys and square detents cut wherever the flow changes footing. Global nav is a keyed list in the margin.
Controls/state: states are printed marks. A detent is hairline at rest, filled pressed, run through when disabled, bracketed on focus; spent is a struck bar. No radius anywhere.
Responsive/motion: the block holds its measure and the annotation margin absorbs width; under two columns the rail goes outboard. Motion is a damped single axis, no overshoot.
rw-centre-rail-reference-setting.webLeverage: The ruling engine is real: a canvas or SVG layer reads live layout boxes and draws every hairline, detent and bracket at one device pixel, re-solving on resize and zoom. The lift relocates in-flow when the margin cannot hold it.

medium-native-algorave-source-floor.name: Algorave Source Floor
medium-native-algorave-source-floor.form: an algorave floor, where projected live code edits the music mid-dance and every thrown bracket changes what a hundred bodies do next
medium-native-algorave-source-floor.spark: The coder deletes half a line and the kick drops out; the crowd howls, the line comes back wrong on purpose, and the room lifts.
system: Palette/material: phosphor green and magenta syntax on projector black, the code buffer as ground; the pattern about to change flashes amber before it sounds
Type/composition: monospaced terminal type at stage scale with hard line breaks as musical bars, the composition one code buffer whose cursor line is the downbeat
Topology/navigation: the source is the stage; sections of code map to audible layers you can follow live.
Controls/state: edits apply on the next cycle boundary; upcoming changes are visible before they sound.
Responsive/motion: code and visuals share one clock; small screens follow a single highlighted pattern lane.
medium-native-algorave-source-floor.webLeverage: Web Audio scheduling ties editable patterns to a shared clock with live evaluation in the page.

digital-design-canon-teletext-weather-mo.name: Teletext Weather Mosaic
digital-design-canon-teletext-weather-mo.form: a broadcast information page drawn entirely from a fixed character cell, weather symbols built from chunky mosaic blocks in seven flat colors, page numbers waiting in the corner while the next subpage cycles in
digital-design-canon-teletext-weather-mo.spark: A weather map made of coloured rectangles, a sun built from four blocks, and a number in the corner counting subpages while you wait for the one you wanted.
system: Palette/material: seven flat saturated colors on pure black, every form built from rectangular mosaic cells with no curve available anywhere
Type/composition: a fixed monospaced grid where headings are double-height, and all imagery assembled from block characters on the same cells
Topology/navigation: everything is addressed by a three-digit page number, so navigation is typing a number rather than following a link
Controls/state: controls are page numbers, the active page holds while its subpages cycle, and unavailable pages return a flat error row
Responsive/motion: the character grid scales only in whole cells, and motion is a subpage swap with no transition at all
digital-design-canon-teletext-weather-mo.webLeverage: a whole-cell responsive character grid, timed subpage cycling state, and page-number addressing in the url

pop-culture-shelf-code-cascade-terminal.name: Code Cascade Terminal
pop-culture-shelf-code-cascade-terminal.form: a cyberpunk glyph-rain terminal, pale green half-width katakana and digits falling in columns of unequal speed, bright leading characters over fading tails, wireframe schematics surfacing through the cascade
pop-culture-shelf-code-cascade-terminal.spark: green glyphs sheet down the dark like rain on glass; you stare until a column slows, katakana snapping into a name you know, and a wireframe city rotates up through the cascade while the rest keeps falling behind your reflection
system: Palette/material: pale phosphor green glyphs on black ground, leading characters burned near white, tails fading through green to charcoal, the active column held brightest
Type/composition: monospaced half-width katakana and digits in strict vertical columns of unequal speed, data locking into readable rows only where you focus
Topology/navigation: content surfaces out of the rain as wireframe panes; you tunnel between layers, the cascade always falling behind the one in focus
Controls/state: hover freezes a column to legibility, selection burns its glyphs white and holds them, idle panes dissolve back into falling texture
Responsive/motion: narrow screens thin the rain to a margin curtain beside one readable pane
pop-culture-shelf-code-cascade-terminal.webLeverage: a canvas loop draws thousands of falling glyphs with per-column speed, css mix-blend-mode screening them over the wireframe svg layer

vernacular-ephemera-jet-age-ticket-walle.name: Jet Age Ticket Wallet
vernacular-ephemera-jet-age-ticket-walle.form: a jet-age airline ticket wallet, where carbon-copy coupons, route maps, and baggage tags choreograph one journey through crisp official color
vernacular-ephemera-jet-age-ticket-walle.spark: Red carbon numerals, a fold-out route arc, a stapled baggage stub: the whole Atlantic crossing fits in a paper wallet.
system: Palette/material: carrier navy and red over crisp white coupon stock, carbon purple for every filled figure, the red VOID stamp owning the cancelled state
Type/composition: airline grotesk caps on tabbed coupon heads, fare and flight boxes ruled in hairlines, carbon numerals striking fixed fields, one leg per sheet
Topology/navigation: the flow is a coupon book; each leg tears off in sequence and the wallet always shows what remains.
Controls/state: validated, used, and void states stamp themselves onto the coupon; nothing disappears, it cancels.
Responsive/motion: coupons stack into a single stub column on phones; tear-off animates once
vernacular-ephemera-jet-age-ticket-walle.webLeverage: Printable, deep-linkable coupon states with URL-addressable legs and offline-capable stubs.

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-moon-sha.name: Moon Shadow Bazaar
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-moon-sha.form: a moon-shadow bazaar, where merchants trade shadows by length, memory, temperature, and the strange light that cast them
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-moon-sha.spark: A vendor unrolls the cool shadow of a cedar at midnight, another offers a child's summer silhouette in a glass jar, and the moon changes price by moving behind a cloud.
system: Palette/material: moonlit blue-black lane as ground, shadow goods in layered soft blacks, stall canvas in muted saffron, one cool moon white edging the active trade
Type/composition: bazaar signpainter script over chalked price caps, stalls ranked down one lane, each shadow tagged with a small ticket of origin and length
Topology/navigation: Wander stalls by shadow origin, shape, time, emotional charge, and possible exchange.
Controls/state: Cast, stretch, compare, trade, and return a shadow while its story stays attached.
Responsive/motion: Arrange stalls as a moonlit vertical lane on phones and retain high-contrast readable commerce.
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-moon-sha.webLeverage: Camera silhouette capture, solar geometry, and interactive shadow deformation turn personal light moments into ephemeral tradable artifacts.

architecture-inhabitable-space-daylight-.name: Daylight Section
architecture-inhabitable-space-daylight-.form: a daylight section, where the sun cuts luminous rooms through a building and daily life gathers along the moving edge of warmth
architecture-inhabitable-space-daylight-.spark: A winter beam enters beneath a deep lintel, climbs a limewashed wall, and reaches a breakfast table at 08:12 before withdrawing into the stair by noon.
system: Palette/material: limewash white walls as ground, section-cut poche in deep charcoal, the traveling sunbeam's gold as the active band, shadow blue for withdrawn hours
Type/composition: architect's inclined lettering with tabular time stamps, the page ruled as one long continuous section, annotations pinned to sun angles
Topology/navigation: Read rooms in section through solar paths, apertures, surfaces, and moments of occupation.
Controls/state: Change date, orientation, and opening depth while comparing useful light and glare.
Responsive/motion: Stack time slices beneath a fixed section on narrow screens and preserve a still noon state.
architecture-inhabitable-space-daylight-.webLeverage: Solar-position computation and a shader-backed section visualize exact daylight paths with numeric lux and glare summaries.

signals-instruments-seven-segment-alarm-.name: Seven Segment Alarm Clock
signals-instruments-seven-segment-alarm-.form: the seven-segment display family, bedside clocks, gas-station price totems, scoreboards, and microwave panels all speaking one eight-cell mask where unlit segments are designed too
signals-instruments-seven-segment-alarm-.spark: At 3am the bedroom hour hangs as four red digits; by noon the same alphabet quotes gasoline at two meters tall, and at the stadium the score slams from 98 to 100 with nothing sliding, segments simply dying and igniting.
system: Palette/material: lit segments in LED red, amber, or scoreboard green on matte near-black ground, unlit segments held as faint ghost cells; red glow owns the night register
Type/composition: one eight-cell mask makes every glyph, digits ranked in fixed slots with the colon or decimal as its own cell; absence is drawn as deliberately as light
Topology/navigation: the layout is a rigid mask of cells, from four bedside digits to a price totem's stack; place never moves, only which segments light

signals-instruments-seven-segment-alarm-.webLeverage: CSS grid and clip-path build a true segment mask with ghost cells, and a shared worker keeps blink phase synchronized across every open tab

ink-pigment-printmaking-mezzotint-velvet.name: Mezzotint Velvet Night
ink-pigment-printmaking-mezzotint-velvet.form: a mezzotint plate rocked entirely to black and polished back toward light, where images emerge by removing darkness rather than drawing shadow
ink-pigment-printmaking-mezzotint-velvet.spark: The first proof is absolute velvet black; after hours of burnishing, a pale face and one silver sleeve surface from the darkness.
system: Palette/material: total rocked velvet black as the ground, burnished silver-white as the only light, warm plate-tone brown at half-scraped passages, nothing ever drawn on white
Type/composition: engraved roman captions confined to the lower margin, the plate itself untitled and dark, tonal masses composed from the black downward toward light
Topology/navigation: Navigate tonal regions from fully rocked ground through scraped and burnished highlights.
Controls/state: Rock, scrape, burnish, proof, and compare with black, opening, luminous, flattened, and worn states.

ink-pigment-printmaking-mezzotint-velvet.webLeverage: A reversible tonal mask can reveal subtractive image formation while retaining every proof state.

design-canon-rietveld-sliding-house.name: Rietveld Sliding House
design-canon-rietveld-sliding-house.form: the Rietveld Schröder house at midday, where sliding primary-color planes reconfigure one small room into many, and every joint stays visibly honest
design-canon-rietveld-sliding-house.spark: A red plane slides, a yellow edge appears, and the living room becomes two bedrooms: the house is a composition you operate.
system: Palette/material: white and gray planes as ground, black frame lines as structural ink, red, yellow, and blue rationed to the sliding edges that actually move
Type/composition: lowercase geometric sans set flush to plane edges, text blocks treated as rectangles in the composition, asymmetric balance ruled by primary-color joints
Topology/navigation: one continuous space partitioned by sliding planes; routes are plane positions, not pages.
Controls/state: panels physically slide to reveal or combine sections; color marks the moving edge, gray holds the frame.
Responsive/motion: planes become stacked sliding sheets on phones; every slide is reversible and announced.
design-canon-rietveld-sliding-house.webLeverage: The View Transitions API and CSS plane slides make layout reconfiguration itself the navigation model.

rivers-tides-ocean-depths-mesophotic-dee.name: Mesophotic Deep Dive
rivers-tides-ocean-depths-mesophotic-dee.form: a technical deep dive down a volcanic island wall, where one small diver leaves the turquoise surface, crosses a cold blue thermocline, and enters a mesophotic garden of black coral, glass sponges, and falling marine snow
rivers-tides-ocean-depths-mesophotic-dee.spark: At forty meters the last warm red drains from the diver's gloves; a lamp clicks on, revealing black-coral branches and white particles falling past a wall with no visible floor.
system: Palette/material: abyssal ink blue deepening by dive stage as the ground, chalk-white marine snow as particle texture, one thermocline cyan band marking the active depth
Type/composition: monospaced dive-computer digits for depth and gas beside quiet grotesk notes, one vertical depth axis ruling every line of copy
Topology/navigation: Descend through surface, thermocline, reef ledge, mesophotic wall, turnaround depth, ascent stops, and the vertical route home.
Controls/state: Descend, hover, illuminate, mark, turn, and ascend with daylight, cooling, dark, gas-limited, decompression, and surfaced states.

rivers-tides-ocean-depths-mesophotic-dee.webLeverage: A synchronized depth-and-time scrub can change light, color, sound, species, and ascent obligations together, while any observation remains pinned to its exact depth and dive phase.

notation-diagram-systems-orienteering-ma.name: Orienteering Map
notation-diagram-systems-orienteering-ma.form: an orienteering map and legend, iso-standard colors where white means runnable forest, contours rule the truth, and the course rides in purple over everything
notation-diagram-systems-orienteering-ma.spark: Thumb on the map and breath ragged, a runner in wet birch forest gambles on the marsh crossing because two contour lines pinch, and the purple line does not care how.
system: Palette/material: isom inks, white runnable forest, olive thicket, yellow open land, brown contours, blue marsh, course purple reserved for the active leg
Type/composition: condensed sans control numerals in purple beside their circles, the legend a ranked symbol table, contour line texture is the page's ground
Topology/navigation: terrain is a fixed color language beneath and the numbered purple course rides above, you travel control to control choosing your own route
Controls/state: each control pairs a circle on the map with a coded description row, punched controls check off, the course layer never edits the terrain

notation-diagram-systems-orienteering-ma.webLeverage: Geolocation tracks your position over the fixed-scale map with the course as an SVG overlay layer.

digital-design-canon-gameboy-four-shade-.name: Gameboy Four Shade Field
digital-design-canon-gameboy-four-shade-.form: a game boy field of four olive greens, 8 by 8 tiles, chunky dither standing in for every gradient, sprites readable as silhouette at postage-stamp size
digital-design-canon-gameboy-four-shade-.spark: you tilt the slab toward the window to catch enough light, four greens resolving into a whole country, the blinking cursor waiting on your next press while the battery lamp burns its warning red
system: Palette/material: exactly four greens, pale 9bbc0f ground, 8bac0f midtone, 306230 shade, near-black 0f380f as ink and active state, a dither checker mixes any fifth tone

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-gravity-.name: Gravity Rain Garden
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-gravity-.form: a gravity-rain garden, where drops fall toward flowers, walls, moons, and walking figures according to the color of each cloud
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-gravity-.spark: Blue rain falls upward into a floating pond, red rain bends around a sleeping fox, and clear drops orbit a black flower without ever touching the ground.
system: Palette/material: dusk green-gray garden as ground, cloud color coding each gravity, blue and red rains as directional accents, the black flower anchoring clear orbits

ikeda-datamatics.name: Ikeda Datamatics
ikeda-datamatics.form: a data-sublime field, where dense barcode columns and sine lattices strobe in pure black and white
ikeda-datamatics.spark: A wall of hairline vertical bars, some black, some white, holds like a frozen barcode. Dense monospace numbers pack the margin. A single sine curve traces the lattice, and for one frame the whole field snaps to its negative.

digital-design-canon-otome-choice-frame.name: Otome Choice Frame
digital-design-canon-otome-choice-frame.form: a japanese romance-game screen where an ornate scrolled window holds the dialogue, a character portrait stands at one side, and three branching choices bloom outward as framed cards with a decaying timer bar beneath them
digital-design-canon-otome-choice-frame.spark: the dialogue sits in a window with scrollwork around it, three choices bloom out like cards being dealt, and a thin bar underneath is quietly emptying while you decide.
system: Palette/material: rose and cream with gold-free ornamental line, soft painted portraits, and a translucent dialogue window over the scene

graphic-worlds-publishing-busytown-cross.name: Busytown Cross Section
graphic-worlds-publishing-busytown-cross.form: a busytown cross-section spread, a cutaway world where every building loses its wall, every vehicle its hull, and every object wears a small printed label, dozens of workers mid-task in one continuous gouache scene
graphic-worlds-publishing-busytown-cross.spark: You lie on the rug tracing a tiny car through a page where the bakery has no front wall, the flour sack says flour, and every fireman, pig, and pickle truck is busy doing exactly what its label promises.

pop-culture-shelf-doujin-event-catalog.name: Doujin Event Catalog
pop-culture-shelf-doujin-event-catalog.form: a convention circle catalog printed on newsprint, thousands of hand-drawn thumbnail squares packed into a numbered hall grid, each square carrying a circle name, a table code and a drawing done at postage-stamp size
pop-culture-shelf-doujin-event-catalog.spark: eight hundred drawings on one page, each one the size of a stamp, each with a table code, and somebody has gone through and circled forty of them in biro with a route planned between them.
system: Palette/material: single-ink black on cheap newsprint that grays under the thumb, with one spot color used only on the hall map dividers

clay-ceramics-fracture-coiled-earth-towe.name: Coiled Earth Tower
clay-ceramics-fracture-coiled-earth-towe.form: a monumental earthen tower built from visible coils, where compression, drying, and hand pressure leave a slow ascending record
clay-ceramics-fracture-coiled-earth-towe.spark: Broad clay ropes circle upward above the maker's head, each thumb-smoothed seam catching a different band of late light.

vernacular-ephemera-socialist-kiosk-prin.name: Socialist Kiosk Print
vernacular-ephemera-socialist-kiosk-prin.form: a state kiosk display of everyday printed goods, matchbox labels and juice cartons and tram tickets sharing one restricted ink set, each carrying a geometric mark from a central design office
vernacular-ephemera-socialist-kiosk-prin.spark: a matchbox, a juice carton and a tram ticket, all printed in the same three inks by the same office, each with a small abstract mark that took somebody a month and nobody was allowed to sign.

pop-culture-shelf-window-box-toy-shelf.name: Window Box Toy Shelf
pop-culture-shelf-window-box-toy-shelf.form: a toy-aisle wall of window-box sets, die-cut cellophane windows opening onto tiny illustrated dioramas, warm cream board trimmed in gingham with a friendly rounded logotype on every lid
pop-culture-shelf-window-box-toy-shelf.spark: You crouch to the third shelf and a thumb-sized kitchen glows behind cellophane, its gingham trim matching the lid, and the whole row of boxes waits like houses with their lights on.
system: Palette/material: warm cream board ground, gingham trims in meadow green, berry and sky blue, cellophane gloss over each window, one sunny yellow shelf tag for the featured set

vernacular-ephemera-well-traveled-passpo.name: Well Traveled Passport
vernacular-ephemera-well-traveled-passpo.form: a well-traveled passport, where visa plates, entry stamps, and security paper accumulate into an involuntary autobiography of borders
vernacular-ephemera-well-traveled-passpo.spark: No two stamps align: purple ovals, faded dates, a full-page visa with a hologram bird, and your face getting older near the front.

pop-culture-shelf-devianart-character-sh.name: Devianart Character Sheet

pop-culture-shelf-devianart-character-sh.spark: four views of a creature nobody asked for, a row of named colors underneath, and in the corner, hand-lettered and underlined twice, a warning about what happens if you steal it.

wayfinding-cartography-signage-terminal-.form: an international airport sign system, saturated yellow panels hung as framed overhead bands, black humanist sans beside white pictograms, arrows placed by strict edge rules, gate numbers at monumental scale down the concourse
wayfinding-cartography-signage-terminal-.spark: Off the jet bridge with nine minutes to make the connection, one yellow band hangs at the corridor junction, black letters and a running-figure pictogram agreeing: gates D1-D57, left, twelve minutes' walk.

graphic-worlds-publishing-sampler-alphab.spark: The alphabet at the top is careful and even, and by the bottom of the cloth the stitches have gone loose and confident, and she signed it aged nine.

clay-ceramics-fracture-glaze-river-shelf.name: Glaze River Shelf
clay-ceramics-fracture-glaze-river-shelf.form: a kiln shelf beneath a row of heavily glazed cups, where molten color pools, runs, stops, and sometimes welds the vessel to the floor
clay-ceramics-fracture-glaze-river-shelf.spark: A cobalt glaze reaches the foot in one thick tear, freezes a millimeter above the shelf, while the cup beside it spills into a glassy blue puddle.

fashion-folded-worlds-sewing-pattern-env.webLeverage: css outlines trace nested size grading while drag interaction snaps svg pieces onto a grain-locked layout grid

pop-culture-shelf-sukeban-long-skirt-cod.name: Sukeban Long Skirt Code
pop-culture-shelf-sukeban-long-skirt-cod.form: a school-uniform subculture's dress code as a coded document, a lengthened pleated skirt and shortened sailor top annotated with rule callouts, group affiliation carried by embroidered collar stripes
pop-culture-shelf-sukeban-long-skirt-cod.spark: the skirt lengthened by exactly this much, the top shortened by exactly that much, every deviation measured and annotated, and the stripe on the collar telling you who she answers to.
system: Palette/material: navy serge and white cotton with a single embroidered stripe color per group, matte cloth with no shine anywhere
Type/composition: annotated rule callouts on leader lines to each modification, a plain condensed sans for labels, and a stripe key ruled at the foot
Topology/navigation: the garment is a document, so navigation follows a leader line from a modification to the rule that governs it
Controls/state: controls are modifications, the active one draws its leader and rule, and non-conforming ones are marked with a struck line
Responsive/motion: callouts reposition around the figure at any width, and motion is a leader line drawing out to its label
pop-culture-shelf-sukeban-long-skirt-cod.webLeverage: an svg figure with animated leader-line callouts, responsive callout repositioning, and conformance state per modification

design-canon-raygun-layout-desk.name: Raygun Layout Desk
design-canon-raygun-layout-desk.form: the layout desk of a surf-culture music magazine, columns colliding mid-sentence, an interview set entirely in dingbats, page numbers lost on purpose
design-canon-raygun-layout-desk.spark: Somewhere beneath three overlapping headlines and a photograph printed straight through the text is an article that swears you will feel it before you can read it.
system: Palette/material: surf-photo bleach tones on uncoated stock ground, dense overprinted black type as body ink, one clashing spot color per spread's loudest fragment
Type/composition: template gothic and battered grotesks at colliding sizes, columns crashing mid-sentence, type printed straight through the photograph when it earns it
Topology/navigation: reading order is earned, not given; the eye enters through the loudest fragment and assembles the page the way you hear a song
Controls/state: emphasis overprints, masks, and shears the type itself; the more urgent the content, the further the grid is allowed to break
Responsive/motion: fragments recompose per viewport into fresh collisions, never a tidy fallback; motion is print-registration slippage
design-canon-raygun-layout-desk.webLeverage: CSS mix-blend-mode overprints and layered grid areas let type collide while staying selectable, real text under the wreckage

hand-drawn-zine-explainer.name: Hand Drawn Zine Explainer
hand-drawn-zine-explainer.form: a hand-drawn technical zine on the web, where marker lettering, doodle arrows, and mascots teach a hard concept the way a friend sketches it on a napkin
hand-drawn-zine-explainer.spark: A cheerful marker headline sits above a doodled diagram, hand-drawn arrows looping from a wide-eyed mascot to a boxed code snippet, highlighter swipes marking the one line that matters as you step through the comic panels.
system: Palette/material: cream paper ground, black marker ink, two or three flat highlighter accents in yellow, pink, and teal
Type/composition: a hand-lettered marker face for headings paired with a clean readable sans for body
Topology/navigation: Move by stepping through numbered comic panels, by clicking mascot-guided call-outs, and by a sketched table-of-contents sidebar.
Controls/state: Hovering a doodle reveals its explanation; highlighter swipes animate across the active line; a mascot changes expression to mark done, warning, and gotcha states.

hand-drawn-zine-explainer.webLeverage: Author diagrams as inline SVG with hand-drawn paths and animate the doodle arrows via stroke-dashoffset draw-on tied to scroll position.

operate-b-normalled-jackfield.name: Normalled Jackfield
operate-b-normalled-jackfield.form: A resumable configuration surface drawn as a jackfield normalling schedule: numbered lanes on unlit black glass where every item is tied to its default by an amber link line that is unbroken, cross-ticked, gapped, doubled or ended in an open ring.
operate-b-normalled-jackfield.spark: A backlit schedule taped inside a machine-room door: amber lanes numbered 01 to 48 on black glass, a solid tie line running to each default, and one line interrupted by a neat hand-inked gap where the operator broke the normal and left it broken.
system: Palette/material: black glass ground, one signal amber for every mark; foreign photos keep their own colour inside an amber hairline frame with a filled amber caption bar.
Type/composition: one condensed grotesque: small-cap legends, upright prose. Rank is inversion, the dominant block knocked dark out of a solid amber plate, one per screen.
Topology/navigation: an endless lane grid drifts under a fixed left legend strip; dark gutters at both edges mean nothing spans full width, and panels snap to numbered lanes.
Controls/state: each item carries a link line: unbroken is live, one cross-tick held, a clean gap disabled, doubled selected, open ring end destructive; no colour carries state.
Responsive/motion: lanes drift one hairline per second under static type; narrow widths drop lanes, never the edge gutters, and a broken link line never animates closed.
operate-b-normalled-jackfield.webLeverage: Every row owns an SVG link rail whose state is drawn by stroke pattern rather than hue: unbroken, cross-tick, gap, doubled, open ring. Lane numbers are durable anchors, so any surface can be re-entered where it broke.

operate-b-exposure-record-zone-sheets.name: Exposure Record Zone Sheets
operate-b-exposure-record-zone-sheets.form: A working field built as a darkroom printer's exposure record: overlapping translucent sheets over a backlit eleven-step zone ramp, where any region carries a hatch density and a stop-delta, and two hatches crossing at ninety degrees mark a conflict.
operate-b-exposure-record-zone-sheets.spark: A taped record card under the enlarger's glow: ruled boxes of seconds and M-filtration numbers, and a tracing-paper overlay askew on top where one region is hatched +1 1/3 and a corner is outlined to be held back.
system: Palette/material: Backlit neutrals snapped to an eleven-step zone ramp; one glowing dichroic magenta marks filtration only; hosted images sit in a two-step mask, never hatched.
Type/composition: Legends in tracked condensed caps, quantities in tabular mono with 1/3 and 2/3 fractions; prose sits only on cleared light zones, hatching halting a line short.
Topology/navigation: Stacked translucent sheets overlap at slight angles, each squared internally; navigating slides a sheet aside instead of replacing the field beneath.
Controls/state: dotted outline is held back, deepest zone is selected, a struck rule is disabled, hatch density is load; two hatches crossing at ninety degrees is a conflict.
Responsive/motion: Sheets carry mass, sliding with slight overshoot before settling; narrow widths stack them one per column with the zone wedge repeating at each band head.
operate-b-exposure-record-zone-sheets.webLeverage: An eleven-step zone ramp as the only tonal tokens, plus a hatch layer where any region takes a numeric weight and a stop-delta, and overlapping regions cross-hatch so conflict renders without colour.

textiles-weave-drape-fashion-jacquard-pu.name: Jacquard Punched Brocade
textiles-weave-drape-fashion-jacquard-pu.form: a jacquard brocade woven from punched instructions, where thousands of binary thread choices resolve into a gold bird across midnight silk
textiles-weave-drape-fashion-jacquard-pu.spark: Rows of tiny holes pass above the loom; beneath them, gold weft slowly gathers into a bird whose wing spans hundreds of separate thread decisions.
system: Palette/material: midnight blue silk as ground, gold weft floats as the accent motif, punch-card cream for instruction rows, warp shadow in near-black ink
Type/composition: monospaced ledger digits for card rows, motif titles in woven small caps, layout banded row by row like the loom's lift sequence
Topology/navigation: Move between finished motif, weave row, card, and individual warp lift with full traceability.
Controls/state: Punch, lift, throw, reverse, and compare with encoded, raised, woven, skipped, and corrected states.
Responsive/motion: Present the loom as synchronized pattern and instruction rows and make every thread choice keyboard inspectable.
textiles-weave-drape-fashion-jacquard-pu.webLeverage: A shared binary matrix can drive textile rendering, editing, and an exact accessible instruction representation.

pop-culture-shelf-rebel-menu-interface.name: Rebel Menu Interface
pop-culture-shelf-rebel-menu-interface.form: a rebel stylish-menu collage, harsh red, black, and white only, torn-paper cutouts and starburst panels at reckless angles, enormous sheared italic display type, halftone dots and comic hatching under perfect usability
pop-culture-shelf-rebel-menu-interface.spark: the menu hits like a poster slammed on a wall: scarlet floods the frame, a silhouette lunges across a starburst, and every option is a torn black shard tilting toward your thumb, the chosen one snapping white with a burst of hatching
system: Palette/material: flat scarlet ground with black torn-paper shapes and white knockout type, halftone gray for texture, the current choice flipped to white-on-black
Type/composition: enormous italic display caps sheared for speed, set at reckless angles yet ranked on a hidden grid, labels punched out of starburst panels
Topology/navigation: menus are full-screen splashes, each choice a jagged cutout at its own angle; a silhouette owns a third of the frame and points the way onward
Controls/state: selection snaps with a full-frame splash and a burst of hatching, the chosen cutout swells while rejected options collapse flat to the edge
Responsive/motion: small screens stack the cutouts down the red field at alternating shear; transitions are single-frame smash cuts
pop-culture-shelf-rebel-menu-interface.webLeverage: css clip-path cuts the torn-paper panels, transforms shear the italic type, and view transitions land the full-frame smash cuts

wayfinding-cartography-signage-salt-stif.name: Salt Stiffened Treasure Map
wayfinding-cartography-signage-salt-stif.form: an old treasure map on salt-stiffened vellum, where a compass rose, missing corner, tide marks, coded marginalia, false trails, and a hand-drawn coastline turn navigation into inference
wayfinding-cartography-signage-salt-stif.spark: Oblique light raises a nearly erased red route beneath the ink; the torn corner aligns with a crescent island, and a tide stain suddenly becomes the boundary of a hidden harbor.
system: Palette/material: salt-stiffened vellum tan with iron-gall sepia ink, tide-stain gray blooms, one faded red route rising under oblique light as the active trail
Type/composition: cramped manuscript hand with a flourished compass rose, coded marginalia crowding the edges, the coastline drawn first and words fit after
Topology/navigation: Move from map edge to landmark, bearing, marginal clue, damaged gap, candidate route, hidden harbor, and final cache hypothesis.
Controls/state: Rotate, measure, reveal, annotate, combine clues, and compare sealed, weathered, suspected, disproved, aligned, and solved states.
Responsive/motion: Center one clue chain on phones while preserving the whole parchment as context
wayfinding-cartography-signage-salt-stif.webLeverage: Deep image zoom, oblique-light layers, URL-addressable annotations, collaborative hypothesis history, and accessible transcription let groups solve the artifact while every inference retains provenance.

pop-culture-shelf-vertical-video-feed-su.name: Vertical Video Feed Surface
pop-culture-shelf-vertical-video-feed-su.form: a full-bleed vertical media surface where one item owns the entire viewport, a right rail of stacked action affordances, an author line and caption anchored low, and the next item already waiting one snap away
pop-culture-shelf-vertical-video-feed-su.spark: One thing fills the whole screen, four glyphs stacked down the right, and the next one is exactly one flick away and already loaded.
system: Palette/material: media fills the frame edge to edge with a soft bottom scrim carrying the text, and pure white glyphs as the only interface color

Topology/navigation: one item at a time occupies everything, so navigation is a single vertical snap between complete states

pop-culture-shelf-vertical-video-feed-su.webLeverage: scroll-snap paging with preloading, engagement counts in live state, and full-viewport media fitting at any aspect

posters-covers-sleeves-risograph-zine-co.name: Risograph Zine Cover
posters-covers-sleeves-risograph-zine-co.form: a small-press zine cover pulled on a duplicator in two spot inks, the layers deliberately misregistered so a third color appears where they overlap, paper showing through the halftone as visible open dots
posters-covers-sleeves-risograph-zine-co.spark: Pink over blue, printed a hair out of line on purpose, and where they cross there is a third color the machine cannot actually make.
system: Palette/material: fluorescent pink and medium blue on newsprint-weight stock, overlapping into a muddy third color, ink sitting visibly on the surface

Topology/navigation: two layers move semi-independently, so navigation shifts one layer against the other to change what the overlap says

design-canon-decollage-torn-billboard.name: Decollage Torn Billboard
design-canon-decollage-torn-billboard.form: a paris hoarding stripped back by hand, layers of pasted posters torn through to expose four earlier campaigns at once, the ragged tear edges becoming the only composition anybody planned
design-canon-decollage-torn-billboard.spark: somebody tore a strip off a wall of posters and found a concert from four years ago underneath, then another, then another, and the accidental edges are better than anything on any of the sheets.
system: Palette/material: aged poster inks bleached to chalk, paste-gray backing board, and the pale fibrous edge every tear exposes

notation-diagram-systems-labanotation.name: Systems Labanotation
notation-diagram-systems-labanotation.form: a labanotation dance score, a vertical center staff read upward where symbol shape is direction, shading is level, and length is exact duration
notation-diagram-systems-labanotation.spark: In a mirrored studio a notator watches the leap twice, then draws a shaded rectangle whose exact height is the half-second the dancer hung in the air.
system: Palette/material: white score paper and black symbol blocks, level encoded as solid, hatched, or dotted fill, the beat in progress banded pale gray across the staff

Topology/navigation: columns flank a center line, left column for left limb and right for right, time flows bottom to top so the future is always above

digital-design-canon-mondo-tech-utopian-.name: Mondo Tech Utopian Spread
digital-design-canon-mondo-tech-utopian-.form: an early-nineties technology magazine spread where fluorescent duotone swallows every element, photography and rules and boxes all printed in the same two impossible inks, angled headline slabs cutting the top third
digital-design-canon-mondo-tech-utopian-.spark: two inks that do not exist in nature, used for absolutely everything on the page including the box rules, with the headline slammed in at eleven degrees and the margin full of definitions.
system: Palette/material: fluorescent orange and cyan as the only two inks in the entire system, applied to photography, rules, boxes and type alike

design-canon-factory-silkscreen-loft.name: Factory Silkscreen Loft
design-canon-factory-silkscreen-loft.form: a silver-foiled loft where celebrity portraits are silkscreened in off-register repeats, drying racks turning one image into thirty deliberate variations
design-canon-factory-silkscreen-loft.spark: Under tinfoil ceilings and one bare red bulb, the same famous face dries thirty times on a rope line, each copy wrong in a slightly more beautiful way.

pop-culture-shelf-streaming-title-card-w.name: Streaming Title Card Wall

pop-culture-shelf-streaming-title-card-w.spark: Rows and rows of artwork, and the one you land on grows and tells you what it is while everything else quietly gets out of the way.

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-sleeping.name: Sleeping City Fold
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-sleeping.form: a sleeping city fold, where streets crease into blankets, towers become bedposts, and neighborhoods dream different weather beneath one night
dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-sleeping.spark: At midnight an avenue rises like a quilt seam, apartment lights become embroidered stars, and a whole district folds gently over a park dreaming tropical rain.

Topology/navigation: Move through waking streets, folded neighborhoods, shared dream edges, and morning return.

dream-surreal-impossible-worlds-sleeping.webLeverage: Deformable map geometry, local time, and collaborative dream fragments create a nightly city that remains spatially recognizable.

dubois-data-portraits.name: Dubois Data Portraits
dubois-data-portraits.form: the 1900 Du Bois data portraits, where hand-inked bars, spirals, and color fields turn hard statistics into unapologetically bold graphic argument
dubois-data-portraits.spark: A crimson spiral coils tighter than the page should allow, gold and black bars slam against hand-lettered captions, and one wandering line carries a population across fifty years.
