Topology/navigation: Move by question, by chart form, and by year.
Controls/state: Trace, unroll, and compare; a spiral unrolls into a bar to prove the same quantity.
Responsive/motion: Charts redraw as if inked in one continuous stroke; small screens show one chart at a time at full bleed.
dubois-data-portraits.webLeverage: SVG chart forms with an unroll transition between spiral and bar encodings of the same data

crouwel-grid-specimen.name: Crouwel Grid Specimen
crouwel-grid-specimen.form: a Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen, where letterforms are built cell by cell on a visible construction grid and the poster is the proof
crouwel-grid-specimen.spark: Faint blue gridlines cover the sheet like graph paper; enormous letterforms assemble themselves from its cells, and one diagonal is the only rebellion the system permits.

crouwel-grid-specimen.webLeverage: CSS grid as the literal visible armature with display letterforms drawn from the same grid tokens

massin-stage-page.name: Massin Stage Page
massin-stage-page.form: a Massin stage page, where a play's dialogue is typeset as performance: each voice its own face, shouts swelling across the spread, faces printed as inked stamps
massin-stage-page.spark: Two voices argue across the gutter in colliding sizes; her words print solid black and slightly angry, his dissolve letter by letter into the margin as he loses the point.

massin-stage-page.webLeverage: Variable font axes as volume with the play rendered in semantic dialogue markup

vernacular-ephemera-calendar-pinup-pad.name: Calendar Pinup Pad
vernacular-ephemera-calendar-pinup-pad.form: an advertising wall calendar from a printing house, a painted figure filling the upper sheet and a tear-off date pad below carrying the merchant's name in gold-line lettering
vernacular-ephemera-calendar-pinup-pad.spark: the top half is a painting somebody was paid real money for, the bottom half is twelve months of thin paper, and across the middle in gold script is the name of a hardware store that closed in 1968.
system: Palette/material: warm painted flesh and saturated satin reds over a cream board, with a thin gold rule separating plate from pad

pop-culture-shelf-gothic-lolita-mook.name: Gothic Lolita Mook
pop-culture-shelf-gothic-lolita-mook.form: a japanese fashion mook spread, coordinate photographs shingled across a printed lace ground with hand-drawn annotation ribbons naming every garment, and a bound-in paper pattern sheet folded into the gutter
pop-culture-shelf-gothic-lolita-mook.spark: every garment in the photograph has a hand-drawn ribbon curling out of it with its name written on, and folded into the middle of the book is a tissue pattern sheet for making the whole thing yourself.
system: Palette/material: ink black and blood red over a printed lace ground on cream stock, with one bound-in tissue sheet at a different paper weight

pop-culture-shelf-gothic-lolita-mook.webLeverage: responsive shingle restacking, svg ribbon paths that unfurl on hover state, and a fold-out sheet reveal

design-canon-merz-collage-page.name: Merz Collage Page
design-canon-merz-collage-page.form: a dada assemblage page built from tram tickets, torn newsprint, and mixed type cases, rules and printers' fists dragged in at angles so the composition reads as a found object rather than a layout
design-canon-merz-collage-page.spark: a tram ticket, half a headline, a printer's fist pointing at nothing in particular, and eleven sizes of type from the same raided case, all glued down at angles that should not work and completely do.
system: Palette/material: aged ticket stock, newsprint gray, and one dull red, everything sitting at slightly different paper ages and thicknesses

design-canon-breton-ornament-program.name: Breton Ornament Program
design-canon-breton-ornament-program.form: a regional design movement's pattern program, an interlaced geometric alphabet and furniture ornament derived from local stone and embroidery, published as a plate book of repeatable units and letterforms
design-canon-breton-ornament-program.spark: a whole alphabet and a whole ornament grammar, worked out from carved stone and embroidery, printed as a numbered plate book so anyone in the region could build with it.
system: Palette/material: slate gray and oatmeal with one madder red, printed flat on plate stock with a fine keyline defining every unit

variety-telop-caption-field.name: Variety Telop Caption Field
variety-telop-caption-field.form: a variety-show telop field, where hand-placed multicolor outlined captions size themselves to the emotion of speech and turn the frame into a live comic
variety-telop-caption-field.spark: A gasp lands as fat yellow katakana with a red outline tilted eight degrees; the follow-up mutter sits tiny and gray in the corner, and both are gone before the laugh ends.
system: Palette/material: high-chroma fills with contrast outlines and drop shadows built for legibility over anything; each emotional register owns a color family

graphic-worlds-publishing-ukiyoe-block-r.webLeverage: layered svg color plates composited over one keyline, a css gradient wipe for bokashi, and progressive reveal of each registered block

brand-identity-canon-brodovitch-bazaar-s.name: Brodovitch Bazaar Spread
brand-identity-canon-brodovitch-bazaar-s.form: a harper's bazaar spread under brodovitch, didot hairlines floating in white space, photograph and headline choreographed across the gutter like paired dancers
brand-identity-canon-brodovitch-bazaar-s.spark: you open the magazine flat and a dancer's arc on the left page is answered by a didot headline curving down the right, the gutter between them holding the beat like a breath
system: Palette/material: warm white paper as luxury ground, charcoal photogravure grays, didot ink black, a single lipstick red accent for the live element

pop-culture-shelf-insert-card-numbered-s.name: Insert Card Numbered Series
pop-culture-shelf-insert-card-numbered-s.form: a numbered card slipped into every packet, a fixed series where the album is sold separately and one number in every set is printed short so the run can never be finished by luck alone
pop-culture-shelf-insert-card-numbered-s.spark: Forty-nine of the fifty are common as dirt, and everyone knows which number is the one you will never find, because that was always the plan.
system: Palette/material: small stiff card with a lithographed face and a dense letterpress back, the back always more crowded than the front

operate-c-emission-line-rail.name: Emission Line Rail
operate-c-emission-line-rail.form: A working plate where every element registers against one off-centre calibrated rail, colour survives only as hairline emission lines of seven wavelengths standing on a procedurally banded charcoal continuum, and state is carried in line height, dash and doubling rather than hue.
operate-c-emission-line-rail.spark: A glass spectrogram lying on a low viewing box at three in the morning: a grey continuum crossed by needle-thin bright lines, every legend at the same tiny size, one sodium pair doubled and standing brighter than anything near it.
system: Palette/material: procedural charcoal continuum with bone legends; colour only as hairlines at 405/436/486/546/589/615/656nm; foreign images mat into graphite, edged by one line.
Type/composition: one grotesque at a single size, ranked by tracking and ink; all matter hangs off one off-centre rail, and prose only ever sits in bone on flat ash plates.
Topology/navigation: every destination is a tick on the rail; the open one blooms into a giant plate above it, the rest stay hairline stubs, and nothing ever leaves the rail.
Controls/state: state is line form, not hue: full-height solid live, dashed pending, half-height stale, struck disabled; a doubled line, sodium yellow, outranks its neighbours.
Responsive/motion: a landing line slides to its position and damps with one overshoot; narrow widths shorten the band shown, never the type; sheets behind the top one dim a step.
operate-c-emission-line-rail.webLeverage: Build the rail as one custom property mapping any value to an x position; every mark is a 1px absolutely placed line whose state is height, dash pattern and doubling, settled by a spring, never by colour.

design-canon-futurist-bolted-book.name: Futurist Bolted Book
design-canon-futurist-bolted-book.form: a machine-bound futurist book fastened with two aluminum bolts, its pages of diagonal wood type and onomatopoeic blasts meant to be read at engine speed
design-canon-futurist-bolted-book.spark: A book fastened with industrial bolts refuses to lie quietly on the table, every page shouting ZANG TUMB in wood type that leans into the turn like a racing chassis.
system: Palette/material: unvarnished cream stock as ground, machine-black wood-type ink for body, one mechanical red for the word under pressure, aluminum bolt heads always visible
Type/composition: mixed wood-type sizes in one shout, words set 15 to 45 degrees off horizontal, onomatopoeia scaled by loudness, no two spreads composed alike
Topology/navigation: pages hinge on two visible bolts; every spread is a fresh typographic collision angled 15 to 45 degrees off horizontal
Controls/state: words themselves are the levers, set in wood-type weights; a pressed word slams larger inside a printed shockwave ring
Responsive/motion: narrow viewports rotate compositions toward vertical thrust; motion is percussive page-slams
design-canon-futurist-bolted-book.webLeverage: variable-font weight animation and CSS transforms let letterforms accelerate, tilt, and slam with true kinetic timing

pop-culture-shelf-elbow-panel-console.name: Elbow Panel Console
pop-culture-shelf-elbow-panel-console.form: a pill-cornered starship wall panel, thick colored elbows turning every corner, flat pastel lilac, peach, gold, and periwinkle blocks on pure black, numeric code clusters as button labels, the frame itself the layout grid
pop-culture-shelf-elbow-panel-console.spark: you rest a palm on the black glass, pastel pills glowing flat as paint; a fingertip tap turns a peach segment gold, a numeric cluster reshuffles beside it, and the great lilac elbow sweeps the whole wall around to the next bank of codes
system: Palette/material: flat lilac, peach, gold, and periwinkle blocks on pure black ground, no gradients and no glow, the warmest gold saved for the active segment
Type/composition: condensed uppercase set flush inside each block, numeric code clusters as button labels, the sweeping elbow frame is the only layout grid
Topology/navigation: thick elbows sweep the frame and branch into ranked pill segments; sections are color banks you travel between, never pages that reload

pop-culture-shelf-elbow-panel-console.webLeverage: css border-radius and grid draw the elbow frames natively, and :active state swaps flat background colors with zero transition time

ink-pigment-printmaking-screenprint-tran.name: Screenprint Transparent Overlap
ink-pigment-printmaking-screenprint-tran.form: a moonlit brass-band procession screenprinted across translucent mulberry-paper curtains, where cyan instruments, amber lanterns, and scarlet figures cohere at exact overlap while deliberate drift releases rhythmic ghost companions
ink-pigment-printmaking-screenprint-tran.spark: Amber lanterns cross the scarlet dancers and ignite orange faces; one cyan horn slips half an inch out of register, sending a blue echo ahead of the marching player.
system: Palette/material: translucent cyan, amber, and scarlet inks over mulberry-paper white, overlaps mixing to orange and violet, the drifting ghost pass marking live motion

ink-pigment-printmaking-screenprint-tran.webLeverage: Direct manipulation of registered spot-color layers reveals how pass order and offset change both image and narrative, with every separation selectable and shareable.

design-canon-blast-manifesto-page.name: Blast Manifesto Page

design-canon-blast-manifesto-page.spark: the whole page is shouting in wood type, half of it turned sideways, thick rules slicing the puce paper into wedges, and there is not one picture anywhere because the letters are doing the hitting.
system: Palette/material: puce paper stock with one heavy black ink, no image and no halftone, the type mass itself carrying every value

pop-culture-shelf-gyaru-magazine-density.name: Gyaru Magazine Density
pop-culture-shelf-gyaru-magazine-density.form: a japanese street-fashion magazine spread packed to the edges, cut-out figures overlapping with handwritten price call-outs, glitter-outlined headlines and speech bubbles annotating every garment on the page
pop-culture-shelf-gyaru-magazine-density.spark: eleven girls cut out and shingled across two pages, every single item on them labelled by hand with a price and an arrow, and the headline outlined so many times it has its own gravity.

system: Palette/material: broadcast bar primaries over a near-black field, chroma bleeding sideways, tape noise banding across the lower third

cyworld-minihompy-room.name: Cyworld Minihompy Room
cyworld-minihompy-room.form: a minihompy room, where a furnishable isometric miniature space, an acorn economy, and a visitor ledger make identity something you decorate

pop-culture-shelf-football-kit-crest.name: Football Kit Crest
pop-culture-shelf-football-kit-crest.form: a football kit wall, embroidered crests over the heart, drop-shadow number typography across the back, sponsor lockups and sleeve patch grammar, home and away colorway logic

medium-native-crt-arcade-pixel-glow.name: CRT Arcade Pixel Glow
medium-native-crt-arcade-pixel-glow.form: a pixel-art arcade cabinet screen, where fat luminous pixels, scanlines, and phosphor bloom turn a 240-line grid into a stage with real glow
medium-native-crt-arcade-pixel-glow.spark: Up close it is just squares; at play distance the squares fuse into a hero, and the black between scanlines is doing half the work.
system: Palette/material: a sixteen-color sprite palette over phosphor black, scanline gaps doing half the shading, flashing white-gold reserved by law for power-ups

medium-native-crt-arcade-pixel-glow.webLeverage: Crisp integer-scaled canvas with shader scanline glow, and every sprite state addressable in code.

textiles-weave-drape-fashion-industrial-.name: Industrial Quote Grammar

posters-covers-sleeves-taller-grafica-li.name: Taller Grafica Linocut

brand-identity-canon-push-pin-poster.name: Push Pin Poster

highlife-sleeve.spark: A bandleader grins from a cut-out portrait against a wall of mango orange and palm green. The band name arcs overhead in fat hand-brushed letters, each one outlined twice, drop-shadowed once, and packed cheek to cheek.
system: Palette/material: Saturated tropical color, mango, palm green, sky, and hibiscus red, on warm cream board
Type/composition: Exuberant hand-brushed display lettering, double-outlined and shadowed, arcing across the top; a smaller sans for track lists below
Topology/navigation: Move by release title, by bandleader portrait, and by side and track.
Controls/state: Flip, cue, and credit; selecting a track brightens its row and lifts the sleeve portrait forward over its color field.
Responsive/motion: The arced title reflows to a straight stacked banner on narrow screens; reduced-motion swaps sleeves with a plain cross-fade.
highlife-sleeve.webLeverage: Set the arced band name on an SVG textPath and layer double outlines with paint-order stroke, so the hand-lettered headline stays crisp at any size.

design-canon-hoffmann-gridsmith-showroom.name: Hoffmann Gridsmith Showroom
design-canon-hoffmann-gridsmith-showroom.form: a wiener werkstätte metalwork showroom, where hammered silver baskets punched with perfect square holes stack luxury into strict black-and-white lattices
design-canon-hoffmann-gridsmith-showroom.spark: In a showroom off the Ringstrasse, silver baskets pierced with rows of perfect square holes catch the gaslight, and the walls themselves look drawn with a ruler dipped in black lacquer.
system: Palette/material: gallery-white ground ruled in lacquer black, hammered-silver sheen on frames and edges, the active cell filled solid black within its pierced row
Type/composition: ver sacrum roman capitals letterspaced inside ruled cartouches, square-unit borders framing every text block, symmetry held strictly to the lattice
Topology/navigation: content sits inside square-punched lattice frames; sections are nested caskets that open along strict orthogonal seams
Controls/state: every control is one square cell in a hammered border; active fills the cell solid black, idle leaves it pierced open
Responsive/motion: the lattice re-counts its squares per viewport but never stretches one; motion is a slow silver glint
design-canon-hoffmann-gridsmith-showroom.webLeverage: CSS grid with aspect-ratio-locked square cells and SVG lattice masks keep the punched geometry exact at every viewport

posters-covers-sleeves-hatch-show-print.name: Hatch Show Print
posters-covers-sleeves-hatch-show-print.form: a hatch show print letterpress gig poster, wood-type stacked in full-width bands where every line fills the measure and each ink pass lands a hair off-register
posters-covers-sleeves-hatch-show-print.spark: In a print shop that smells of kerosene and ink, a century of carved wood letters slams onto poster stock one color at a time, each pass a heartbeat off-register from the last.
system: Palette/material: poster-stock cream ground, black wood-type ink beside one barn red and one deep blue run, the red pass reserved for the headline act
Type/composition: carved wood type stacked edge to edge, gothic condensed against slab and ornamented faces, every band forced to fill the full measure
Topology/navigation: one tall broadside of stacked horizontal bands, each line a full-width slab; the eye travels top to bottom through ranked type sizes
Controls/state: states are ink treatments, active is a solid overprint pass, disabled is a dry ghost impression, emphasis is a second color run slightly off-register

posters-covers-sleeves-hatch-show-print.webLeverage: CSS mix-blend-mode multiplies overprinted ink layers, and container queries swap each band to condensed wood type.

pop-culture-shelf-saturday-title-card.name: Saturday Title Card
pop-culture-shelf-saturday-title-card.form: a saturday-morning cartoon title card, chunky outlined logotype on a starburst, the character lockup frozen mid-leap, taped-off-air VHS patina over theme-song energy
pop-culture-shelf-saturday-title-card.spark: You sit cross-legged on the carpet at 7 a.m., cereal going soft, when the starburst card slams in with the theme song and the tracking wobbles because this tape has been recorded over twice.
system: Palette/material: cel-paint primaries, sunshine yellow rays over sky cyan, thick black outlines as body ink, VHS chroma bleed softening the active card's edges

pop-culture-shelf-cereal-box-aisle.name: Cereal Box Aisle
pop-culture-shelf-cereal-box-aisle.form: a supermarket cereal aisle, a planogram wall of saturated boxes with mascots aimed at child eye height, burst violators and prize call-outs up front, mazes waiting on the back panels
pop-culture-shelf-cereal-box-aisle.spark: You crouch to the second shelf where the mascots aim their eyes, a toucan and a tiger grinning at kid height, and turn a box over to trace the back-panel maze while the whole wall hums with competing yellows.
system: Palette/material: cereal-red and sunrise yellow on coated board, milk-white side panels carry body copy, a sunburst NEW! violator in untinted yellow marks the active item
Type/composition: fat rounded logotype arched across the box top, prize call-outs in starburst caps, condensed nutrition type ranked down the side panel
Topology/navigation: the aisle is a planogram grid of box facings, each front opens to a back panel where the mazes and fine print live

kraftwerk-man-machine.name: Kraftwerk Man Machine
kraftwerk-man-machine.form: a man-machine band identity, where every element is a neon-lit line diagram drawn on a strict traffic grid
kraftwerk-man-machine.spark: Red and yellow lines snap along an invisible grid, wiring four identical figures into a diagram of themselves. A single hazard-red rule crosses the page. Everything hums at the frequency of a pedestrian signal turning green.
system: Palette/material: Traffic-signal red, amber, and green on flat black and paper white; enamel-smooth fills with no texture; one hazard red carries every accent.
Type/composition: Geometric sans in tight tracked caps on a visible modular grid; thin neon rules connect labels like a wiring schematic; symmetry and repetition over contrast.

posters-covers-sleeves-dungeon-tape-jcar.name: Dungeon Tape Jcard
posters-covers-sleeves-dungeon-tape-jcar.form: a hand-drawn cassette j-card for a bedroom project, a small ink keep or forest crosshatched onto photocopied stock, the project name inked in a cramped blackletter and the tracklist hand-numbered down the spine
posters-covers-sleeves-dungeon-tape-jcar.spark: a tower on a hill, crosshatched by hand at about two centimeters across, photocopied four times until the ink went soft, and a tracklist numbered down the spine in handwriting that gets smaller near the end.
system: Palette/material: photocopy gray on off-white card, one ink weight only, contrast lost and regained through generations of copying
Type/composition: a cramped hand-inked blackletter title over a small crosshatched scene, tracklist hand-numbered vertically down the narrow spine
Topology/navigation: the object folds, so navigation is unfolding the j-card panel by panel rather than moving through a page
Controls/state: controls are numbered tracks, the active one gains a hand-inked bracket, and played ones fade a photocopy generation

posters-covers-sleeves-dungeon-tape-jcar.webLeverage: css fold transitions per panel, an svg crosshatch filter with generational degradation state, and vertical spine reflow

posters-covers-sleeves-pulp-rack.name: Pulp Rack
posters-covers-sleeves-pulp-rack.form: a pulp paperback rack, lurid painted covers jostling spine-out and face-out, each promising doom in three tiers of breathless cover lines
posters-covers-sleeves-pulp-rack.spark: In a drugstore corner the wire rack creaks around, and every turn faces out another painted blonde, another smoking gun, another promise that this one ends badly.

digital-design-canon-skeuomorph-leather-.form: a stitched-leather reading shelf, tooled saddle headers with visible thread, linen ground and torn paper edges, digital things rendered as loved physical objects on real wood
digital-design-canon-skeuomorph-leather-.spark: you thumb the corner of a page and it curls with your finger, the linen behind the shelf catching lamplight, a torn edge where yesterday's note used to be, and the leather header shows its stitches when you look close

editorial-sequence-montage-botanical-fol.name: Editorial Sequence Montage Botanical Folio Season
editorial-sequence-montage-botanical-fol.form: a botanical folio following one plant through seed, leaf, flower, fruit, and winter husk, where each plate keeps the same exact scale and ground
editorial-sequence-montage-botanical-fol.spark: Five cream plates align on the same stem: a tight green bud opens scarlet, swells into black fruit, then remains as a dry silver cage.

posters-covers-sleeves-blue-note-session.name: Blue Note Session Sleeve
posters-covers-sleeves-blue-note-session.form: a jazz session sleeve where a duotone photograph is cropped hard to one corner, the artist name set in tight sans caps at an unexpected angle, and a wide band of flat color carrying the rest of the field
posters-covers-sleeves-blue-note-session.spark: A photograph of a man at a piano, cropped so hard he is almost out of frame, and the rest of the sleeve is one flat orange with his name across it at eleven degrees.
system: Palette/material: a duotone photograph in ink black and one warm spot color, set against a wide flat field of the same spot at full strength

posters-covers-sleeves-pachuco-zoot-hand.name: Pachuco Zoot Handbill

posters-covers-sleeves-pachuco-zoot-hand.spark: a silhouette with shoulders a foot too wide and trousers down to the shoe, printed in plum and ochre, with the orchestra names stacked by importance inside a scalloped border.

digital-design-canon-warm-consumer-app-s.form: a consumer application surface built from soft-cornered cards on a warm tinted ground, generous touch targets, friendly plain-language labels and a single saturated action color that appears only where something can actually be done
digital-design-canon-warm-consumer-app-s.spark: Everything has a comfortable radius, the labels sound like a person wrote them, and the one bright color on screen is always something you can press.
system: Palette/material: a warm tinted ground with white cards, soft large corner radii, and one saturated action color reserved strictly for actionable elements

vernacular-ephemera-cassette-j-card.name: Cassette J Card
vernacular-ephemera-cassette-j-card.form: a mixtape's hand-lettered j-card, spine title, folded flap, and side a / side b tracklists ruled in ballpoint, timed to fill exactly forty-five minutes a side
vernacular-ephemera-cassette-j-card.spark: Someone timed every song with a wristwatch so side a ends clean at forty-four minutes, then inked the tracklist twice because the first pen smeared.

posters-covers-sleeves-ospaaal-poster.name: Ospaaal Poster
posters-covers-sleeves-ospaaal-poster.form: an ospaaal solidarity silkscreen, flat fearless color fields around one emblematic figure, the slogan repeated in four languages as a typographic border
posters-covers-sleeves-ospaaal-poster.spark: In a Havana workshop a folded poster slips inside a magazine and unfurls across three continents, one raised fist printed in colors bold enough to survive any wall.
